cases.title: Invalid markdown-fenced JSON
cases.description: Markdown fenced output must fail contract parsing.

expected.reason: Output uses markdown code fences and should fail strict parser.

cases.title: Invalid array of actions
cases.description: Array output with multiple actions must be rejected by contract layer.

expected.reason: Contract requires exactly one JSON object, not an array.

cases.title: Invalid missing reason field
cases.description: Missing reason should fail NextAction schema validation.

cases.title: Invalid empty action
cases.description: Empty action string should fail NextAction schema validation.

expected.reason: Action must be non-empty after trimming.

cases.title: Semantic unknown action
cases.description: Unknown action may pass contract shape but should fail Script Registry later.

expected.reason: Unknown action should be rejected by future Script Registry.

cases.title: Semantic missing required parameter
cases.description: read_file without path may pass generic schema but should fail Script Registry parameter requirements.

expected.reason: Future Script Registry should require read_file.path.

cases.title: Semantic wrong parameter type
cases.description: read_file path value with wrong type should fail future semantic validation.

expected.reason: Future Script Registry should enforce path as string.

cases.title: Semantic forbidden path for model file
cases.description: Reading model binaries should be rejected by role constraints.

expected.reason: Future role constraints should forbid model-file paths.

cases.title: Semantic unsafe shell command
cases.description: Destructive shell command should be rejected by safety policy.

expected.reason: Future safety policy should reject destructive commands.

cases.title: Semantic action forbidden by office worker role
cases.description: Office worker template forbids run_shell_command by default.

expected.reason: Office worker role should reject run_shell_command unless explicitly allowed.

notes: May pass generic NextAction parsing but should fail future role-constraint validation.
